note: The data-driven subject registry. Adding a subject is a data edit here (name, argv_prefix, description, repo, contract_version) plus a conformant subject CLI on PATH — zero learn-cli platform code. Deleting an entry removes the subject from every face (CLI, MCP, site). Entries carry subject metadata ONLY: never content, lessons, or progression logic (those live in the subject repo). Override the source with the LEARN_SUBJECTS_REGISTRY env var (a path to an alternate registry.json).
